When the new-round owner-only endpoints were added, ROUTES was updated with the third-tuple element (true) and OwnerRoute correctly redirects staff, but the corresponding NAV items in Layout.jsx were not flagged with owner:true (except /staf). Result: staff still sees the owner links in the sidebar even though clicking them redirects. Fix: add owner:true to the 6 NAV entries listed above and add the 4 missing new-round nav items.
